p1.text: You've put AI agents on Kubernetes. They can read logs, check rollouts, and find the cause.
p1.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] You've put AI agents on Kubernetes. They can read logs, check rollouts, and find the cause.

p2.text: But they only work when someone opens a prompt and asks.
p2.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] But they only work when someone opens a prompt and asks.

p3.text: Alerts fire in your monitoring. Questions come up in chat. Your agents hear neither.
p3.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Alerts fire in your monitoring. Questions come up in chat. Your agents hear neither.

reveal.text: Introducing Agent Kourier: a Kubernetes-native broker between team chat and A2A agents.
reveal.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Introducing Agent Courier: a Kubernetes-native broker between team chat and A-to-A agents.

promise.text: An alert, or a question, becomes an agent session, in the thread where it landed. Slack today.
promise.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] An alert, or a question, becomes an agent session, in the thread where it landed. Slack today.

r1.text: When an alert lands in the channel, Agent Kourier picks it up, opens the thread, and hands it to your agent. It investigates right there, step by step, and reports what it found.
r1.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] When an alert lands in the channel, Agent Courier picks it up, opens the thread, and hands it to your agent. It investigates right there, step by step, and reports what it found.

r2.text: Reply in the thread, and the same session continues. Same context, nothing re-explained.
r2.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Reply in the thread, and the same session continues. Same context, nothing re-explained.

r3.text: Or skip the alert, and just ask.
r3.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Or skip the alert, and just ask.

r4.text: When the agent needs a decision, it asks, and waits for your answer.
r4.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] When the agent needs a decision, it asks, and waits for your answer.

yaml.text: Teams add one Binding, in YAML, next to their agent. The platform wiring is shared.
yaml.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Teams add one Binding, in YAML, next to their agent. The platform wiring is shared.

close.text: It works with kagent, or any A2A agent that streams. It's a two-way session: it answers as it works, asks when it needs you, and keeps the context when you reply. Slack today; more chat platforms are planned. Agent Kourier. Write the agent, not the chat integration.
close.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] It works with K agent, or any A-to-A agent that streams. It's a two-way session: it answers as it works, asks when it needs you, and keeps the context when you reply. Slack today; more chat platforms are planned. Agent Courier. Write the agent, not the chat integration.

t-problem.text: Your agent is ready. The chat integration is another project.
t-problem.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Your agent is ready. The chat integration is another project.
